title: Ring colimit with geometric affine chart comparisons
statement: Under def-pc-scheme and def-pc-base-change, for a directed ring diagram with affine limiting spectrum cone, a fixed stage i and an affine member of an open cover V of Xi over Spec(R_i), there is a ring diagram F on the upper tail above i and a colimit isomorphism q to the fixed limit chart ring. Each F_j is isomorphic to the stage chart ring. There is a scheme isomorphism h from the iterated limit chart to the fixed limit chart which commutes with the maps to the ambient limit base change, and whose induced ring map identifies the colimit cocone map with the chart pullback map.

source.place: Stacks Tags 01ZR and 01I6, affine reduction and pullback pasting

proof.text: Apply exists_affine_chart_upper_tail_limit to obtain the affine scheme diagram D, limiting cone d, vertex comparison z and stage comparisons e,h with their projection equations. Define F = D.rightOp followed by Scheme.Γ. Mathlib preservesColimit_Γ and isColimitCoconeRightOpOfCone make the global-sections cocone a colimit. Its unique comparison with colimit F gives q₀; compose q₀ with the inverse of Γ(z.op) to obtain q. At each stage take the inverse of Γ(e.op) as the stage ring comparison and keep h. The ambient-map equation is already supplied by the helper. The colimit comparison equation identifies colimit.ι followed by q₀ with the sections map of d.π. Apply Scheme.Hom.appTop to the geometric projection equation and use comp_appTop; cancel the two inverse sections maps of e to obtain the required ring-map equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_chart_ring_colimit_geometric
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (V : Xi.OpenCover.{u}) (a : V.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (V.X a)) :
    let W := V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (c.π.app (op i)))
    let Z := W.X a
    ∃ F : {j : I // i ≤ j} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u},
      ∃ q : colimit F ≅ Γ(Z, ⊤),
      ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
        let U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property)))).OpenCover.{u} :=
          V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))
        let p := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j.val)) (c.w (homOfLE j.property).op))
        let Y := (U.pullback₁ p).X a
        ∃ (e : F.obj j ≅ Γ(U.X a, ⊤)) (h : Y ≅ Z),
          h.hom ≫ W.f a = (U.pullback₁ p).f a ∧
          colimit.ι F j ≫ q.hom ≫ (Scheme.Γ.mapIso h.op).hom =
            e.hom ≫ (U.pullbackHom p a).appTop
